narrationTexts: Confirms it: only rows with both a discount and tax fail, exactly where `orderTotal` computes tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`.**

Only 3 of 625 cases failed, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount, so it only showed up on rows with both a nonzero discount and nonzero tax.

Next: nothing, suite's clean.
